system_overview: This module provides a library of theorems for inductive proofs and recursive definitions over the natural numbers. It is part of the standard proof library used by the TLA Proof System (TLAPS). It includes standard mathematical induction, downward induction, course-of-values (strong) induction, the least-number principle, and theorems justifying recursively defined functions over the naturals and finite intervals.
actors_and_components: There are no actors or concurrent components. This is a purely mathematical module providing proof infrastructure for reasoning about natural numbers.
additional_assumptions: This is a helper module from the standard proof library. It defines no behavior or temporal properties. The theorems are stated with their definitions decomposed to make it easier for proof backends to instantiate them and for proof authors to use.
